test_title: PYST 81: SSC CGL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: In a circular race of 1600 m in length, Bhaskar and Vinay start with speeds of 27 km/h and 45 km/h starting at the same time from the same point. When will they meet for the first time on the track when running in the opposite directions and the same direction, respectively?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speeds in m/s: Bhaskar = 27 × 5/18 = 7.5 m/s, Vinay = 45 × 5/18 = 12.5 m/s.

Relative speed (Opposite) = 7.5 + 12.5 = 20 m/s ⇒ Time = 1600 ÷ 20 = 80 s = 1 minute 20 seconds.

Relative speed (Same) = 12.5 − 7.5 = 5 m/s ⇒ Time = 1600 ÷ 5 = 320 s = 5 minutes 20 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 minute 20 seconds and 5 minutes 20 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the track = 1600 m

Speed of Bhaskar = 27 km/h

Speed of Vinay = 45 km/h

**Formulas Used:**

Speed in m/s = Speed in km/h × 5/18

Time to meet (opposite direction) = Distance ÷ (S₁ + S₂)

Time to meet (same direction) = Distance ÷ |S₁ − S₂|

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5054ecff9576e91156f6419e3fd8368b136d003d0114df6cde0187fe93d7df79.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed of Bhaskar (S₁) = 27 × 5/18 = 7.5 m/s

⇒ Speed of Vinay (S₂) = 45 × 5/18 = 12.5 m/s

⇒ **Case 1: Running in opposite directions**

⇒ Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂ = 7.5 + 12.5 = 20 m/s

⇒ Time taken to meet = 1600 ÷ 20 = 80 seconds = 1 minute 20 seconds

⇒ **Case 2: Running in the same direction**

⇒ Relative Speed = |S₁ − S₂| = 12.5 − 7.5 = 5 m/s

⇒ Time taken to meet = 1600 ÷ 5 = 320 seconds = 5 minutes 20 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 1 minute 20 seconds and 5 minutes 20 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Meeting at the Starting Point

The time taken to meet at the starting point for the first time is the LCM of the times taken by each person to complete one full round independently: LCM(T₁, T₂).

Number of Distinct Meeting Points

If the ratio of their speeds is a : b (in its simplest form), they will meet at (a + b) distinct points when running in opposite directions, and at |a − b| distinct points when running in the same direction.

First Meeting Anywhere on Track

For meeting anywhere on the track for the very first time, use the relative speed directly. Opposite direction relative speed = S₁ + S₂ | Same direction relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|.
